answer: Here is one mechanism that works: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because relic only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, terrace is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any ocean approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
